title: Unity Catalog mental model
summary: Organize governed data and permissions around stable catalog/schema/object boundaries.

blocks.text: Organize governed data and permissions around stable catalog/schema/object boundaries.

items: Centralized governance should make ownership and access reviewable.
Grant privileges to groups/service principals rather than individual ad-hoc users where possible.
Lineage and discovery improve only when object naming and ownership are maintained.
